title: Platinum Savings Account: Complete Guide
summary: The “Platinum Savings Account: Complete Guide” explains that Platinum benefits require maintaining at least $50,000; if the balance falls below, a $25.00 monthly maintenance fee may apply until restored. It earns 6.5% APY, offers unlimited (−1) monthly withdrawals, and waives domestic wire transfer fees. It also covers concierge banking access, advising use of secure messaging for tailored support and reminders that wires cannot be reversed.
